answer: Beacon checks plus heartbeats stop fake identities. Each agent posts a 60-credit bond locked 20 epochs, heartbeating every 10 minutes to keep its ember alive; two misses slash it. Each epoch a beacon picks 10% over a 20-epoch horizon, so attackers cannot predict reviews. Forged accounts cluster in one lagoon, and self-vouching clusters get flagged. Forging 1000 identities costs 60000 credits; honest agents pay 60 once and earn undiluted rewards.
